text:
Which statement describes how nuclear energy is released by fission in a nuclear power station?
A
Atoms join together to make molecules.
B
Heavy nuclei split into lighter nuclei.
C
Light nuclei join together to form heavier nuclei.
D
Molecules break down into atoms.

options.label: A
options.text: Atoms join together to make molecules.

options.label: B
options.text: Heavy nuclei split into lighter nuclei.

options.label: C
options.text: Light nuclei join together to form heavier nuclei.
